narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>We need twenty four tiles, one for each square!
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But each tile covers two of the squares, not only one of them.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That means twenty four squares need only half as many tiles, which is twelve.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Fill one column with upright tiles, then repeat it across the grid.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Tile a grid of four rows and eight columns, and count your tiles.
